exchange: Kennedy asks whether Biden or his staff told Garland to prosecute Trump; Smith: 'Again, I have no idea about that.' Kennedy: 'Do you believe in the tooth fairy?' 'I do not.' 'How about the Easter Bunny?' 'I no longer believe in the Easter Bunny.' Later on toll records of senators: Smith didn't tell Judge Boasberg he was seeking members' phone records ('In seeking nondisclosure orders, we did not disclose'); Kennedy: 'You make me want to throw up in my mouth.' Durbin then objects.
